name: SKAVEN: VERMINLORD CORRUPTOR
description: Verminlord Corruptors are avatars of foulness, vile beyond words. These rat-daemons are entities of utmost reverence for the Clans Pestilens – bloated parasites burrow through their matted fur and slime drips from their sickle blades. Bubos throb across their towering frames, and the air around them becomes choked with noxious yellow fog.</br></br>This multipart plastic kit builds one Verminlord Corruptor, a diseased daemon for your Skaven armies in games of Warhammer Age of Sigmar. Wielding a pair of poisoned plaguereapers, they release their twisted maladies upon their enemies, weakening and withering them. This disgusting creature is ideal for leading the prayers of a Clans Pestilens force as they spread the Great Plagues across the battlefield.</br></br>This kit can alternatively build a Verminlord Warbringer, Verminlord Deceiver, Verminlord Warpseer, or Lord Skreech Verminking. Each variant is an impressive centrepiece miniature for your collection and brings a selection of different abilities to your games.</br></br>This kit comprises 61 plastic components, and 1x Citadel 120mm by 92mm Oval Base. This miniature requires assembly and is supplied unpainted – we recommend using Citadel Plastic Glue and Citadel Colour paints.
